doc.title: Dick Hyman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Organ work, singers and Russia tour
title: Dream band and the preference for solo piano
summary: Picking a dream band is too hard, which is why he prefers solo piano.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Let’s suppose you could put together a dream band and go on a dream tour. Would it be too hard to pick people ...
It would. That is why I prefer to play solo piano because I lose a great many of these complications.
